_doc: THE NOTEBOOK'S DECLARED BEHAVIOUR (source-grounded Q&A, NotebookLM-style). retrieval: passages are chunked on the phone; BM25 over the user's own sources is the floor and the fallback. When the fleet embeddings + rerank service answers (mesh only; base URL baked from the fleet declaration as BuildConfig.EMBED_API_URL, served by cloud-u-containers infra-ai_embeddings-api: bge-m3 embeddings, bge-reranker-v2-m3 rerank), retrieval is hybrid: dense candidates plus BM25 hits, re-scored by the reranker (retrieval.semantic: model names as the service serves them, candidates sent to the reranker, min_rerank = the reranker score a passage needs to be evidence, min_cosine = the floor when only embeddings answered, batching and timeouts, retry_after_ms = how long a failed service is left alone). A PDF source is turned into text by the same service (POST /pdf). chunk_chars/overlap_chars cut each source, top_k passages go to the model, min_coverage is the share of the question's distinct terms a passage must contain to be evidence (BM25 only orders them). No passage that qualifies = the model is NOT called and the refusal is returned. grounding: the system prompt the model gets with the numbered passages; it must cite [n] after every claim or answer exactly the refusal line; an answer with no valid citation is replaced by the refusal. generators: one prompt per studio output, run over the first max_source_chars of the sources only.
refusal: This is not in your sources.

grounding.system:
You answer ONLY from the numbered passages the user supplies. Rules: use no outside knowledge, not even common knowledge; cite the passage number in square brackets, like [2], after every claim; if the passages do not contain the answer, reply with exactly: {{refusal}}
Do not guess, do not extend, do not answer from memory.

generators.system: You work ONLY from the sources below. Use no outside knowledge. Cite sources as [n] where n is the source number. If the sources are too thin, say {{refusal}}

summary.label: Summary
summary.prompt: Write a concise summary of the sources: the main points as short bullets, each with its [n] citation.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.prompt: Write an FAQ of 5 to 8 questions a reader of these sources would ask, each followed by an answer taken only from the sources, with [n] citations.

notes.label: Study notes
notes.prompt: Write structured study notes: headings, key terms with definitions, and key facts, each fact with its [n] citation.
